body:
## Pull request overview

Refactors ObjectQL table UX by unifying “grid” behavior into `ObjectTable`, introducing a new field type metadata system + cell renderers, and updating documentation/examples accordingly.

**Changes:**
- Extended `ObjectTableSchema` with grid-mode flags (`editable`, `keyboardNavigation`, `frozenColumns`, `resizableColumns`).
- Added comprehensive `FieldMetadata` type system and exported it from `@object-ui/types`.
- Added field-type cell renderers + tests and updated docs to describe the unified approach.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 13 out of 13 changed files in this pull request and generated 23 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/objectql.ts | Adds grid-mode-related schema properties to `ObjectTableSchema`. |
| packages/types/src/index.ts | Re-exports the new field type metadata system from `@object-ui/types`. |
| packages/types/src/field-types.ts | Introduces the new `FieldMetadata` type system for ObjectQL fields. |
| packages/plugin-object/src/index.tsx | Exports field renderers and adds schema inputs for ObjectTable in the registry. |
| packages/plugin-object/src/field-renderers.tsx | Adds type-specific cell renderers and `getCellRenderer`. |
| packages/plugin-object/src/__tests__/field-renderers.test.tsx | Adds unit tests for the new field renderers. |
| packages/plugin-object/src/ObjectTable.tsx | Refactors ObjectTable to build on `data-table` and attempts type-aware columns/actions. |
| docs/reference/objecttable-refactored.md | Adds a reference doc describing the refactor and migration guidance. |
| docs/reference/field-types.md | Adds a field types reference doc. |
| docs/reference/field-types-examples.md | Adds detailed examples for field types usage in forms/tables. |
| docs/IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md | Adds an implementation summary / roadmap doc. |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-object/object-table.mdx | Updates public docs for unified ObjectTable (traditional + grid mode). |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-object/index.mdx | Updates plugin overview docs to reflect unified ObjectTable + field renderers. |
</details>

`resizableColumns` is set to `true` when undefined, but `ObjectTableSchema.resizableColumns` is documented with `@default false` in `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`. Please align the runtime default with the schema docs (or update the docs/default).
```suggestion
    resizableColumns: schema.resizableColumns !== undefined ? schema.resizableColumns : false,
```

The ComponentRegistry inputs for `object-table` still use legacy prop names (`columns`, `searchable`) but `ObjectTableSchema` defines `fields`, `showSearch`, etc. This mismatch will cause schema-driven editors to generate invalid configs. Update the inputs to match the actual schema shape.
```suggestion
    { name: 'fields', type: 'array', label: 'Fields' },
    { name: 'showSearch', type: 'boolean', label: 'Show Search', defaultValue: true },
```

`generateColumns()` sets a `cell` renderer (via `getCellRenderer`), but the current `data-table` renderer ignores `TableColumn.cell` and renders cells as `row[col.accessorKey]` (see `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`). This means the type-aware renderers won’t actually run. Either update `data-table` to call `col.cell(value, row)` when provided, or change `ObjectTable` to use a table implementation that supports custom cell rendering.

`hasActions` enables `rowActions`, but `data-table` action buttons are wired to `schema.onRowEdit`/`schema.onRowDelete`. Since those callbacks aren’t set here, the edit/delete icons will render but do nothing. Map `onEdit`/`onDelete` to `onRowEdit`/`onRowDelete` on `dataTableSchema` (and consider dropping the custom actions column).

`ObjectTableProps` still exposes `onRowClick`, `onBulkDelete`, and `onCellChange`, but they aren’t used anymore. This creates a misleading public API—either wire them to the underlying `data-table` (or grid-mode implementation) or remove/deprecate them.

`schema.selectable` supports `'single' | 'multiple'`, but it’s coerced via `!!schema.selectable`, losing the selection mode. Since `data-table` currently only supports boolean selection (checkbox multi-select), either implement single-select behavior or narrow `ObjectTableSchema.selectable` to `boolean` to avoid misleading API.

`BaseFieldMetadata.defaultValue` is typed as `any`, which leaks `any` into consumers and undermines the “comprehensive type system” goal. Consider making `BaseFieldMetadata` generic over the value type (e.g., `BaseFieldMetadata<TValue>`) so `defaultValue` is strongly typed per field kind.

Grid mode example still uses `type: 'object-grid'`, but the PR description says `object-grid` is removed and grid mode is enabled via `type: 'object-table'` + `editable: true`. Update these examples to avoid documenting a removed type.

`ComponentDemo` is imported but never used in this MDX file. Unused imports can break MDX/TS build pipelines depending on configuration—remove it or add the missing usage.
```suggestion

```

This summary states the work upgrades “ObjectForm and ObjectGrid components”, but the PR goal is to merge/remove `ObjectGrid` in favor of a unified `ObjectTable`. Please update the summary wording to reflect the actual public API.

This section references `ObjectGridSchema` and `ObjectGrid` as the target architecture, but the PR description states `object-grid` was removed in favor of a unified `ObjectTableSchema`. Update/remove these references to prevent readers from adopting a deprecated type.

In the schema-fetch effect, remote mode without a `dataSource` is silently ignored (`fetchObjectSchema` is only called when `dataSource` is truthy). That leaves `loading` stuck `true` with no error. Consider explicitly setting an error when `!hasInlineData && !dataSource`.

Renderers frequently cast `field` to `any` to access type-specific metadata (e.g., `precision`, `currency`). Since `FieldMetadata` is a discriminated union, prefer narrowing on `field.type` (or per-renderer prop types) to keep type safety and catch invalid metadata at compile time.

The doc says field types are for “ObjectGrid and ObjectForm”, but `object-grid` is being removed/unified into `ObjectTable`. Update this to “ObjectTable and ObjectForm” (and adjust other references accordingly) to prevent confusion.
```suggestion
ObjectUI supports a comprehensive set of field types for ObjectTable and ObjectForm components, designed to handle all data types commonly found in business applications.
```

`ValidationFunction` takes `value: any`, which propagates `any` into consumer code. Consider using `unknown` (and narrowing inside implementations) or parameterizing the field metadata types so validation functions receive the correct value type per field kind.
```suggestion
export type ValidationFunction = (value: unknown) => boolean | string | Promise<boolean | string>;
```

The summary claims “Proper type safety … (no `any`)”, but the new field type definitions include `any` (e.g., `defaultValue?: any` in `packages/types/src/field-types.ts`). Either update the types to match the claim or adjust the documentation to reflect the current typing strategy.
